in_marathi.name: Gopalakrishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopalakrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gopalakrishna is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Gopala and Krishna. Gopala means 'Cowherder' and Krishna means 'Black'. Together, this name signifies the divine cowherd, who is also known as the black god. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as a cowherd who protects and nurtures the cows in Vrindavan.
